description: Agent Handoffs: submit the lists of agents an organisation keeps (each with its keeper, whether the organisation names it the roster, how it is kept current, when it was last updated and the agents it lists with each owner), the agents added, changed or retired with when the roster showed each change, and how soon a change should reach the roster. The signed report says whether a single roster exists and names no list at all, several lists with none or more than one named the roster, and an added agent the roster does not show (a fleet known only by anecdote), then every agent known only to a side list, every agent with no owner, a roster with no keeper or no update practice, every change the roster never showed or showed late and every retired agent still listed, with the fix for each. This reads whether the organisation keeps one roster and keeps it current as agents come and go: whether one registry covers what deployment, usage, credential and billing lists show is wever_agent-registry-check, and the outside surfaces where buying agents find a seller are wever_discovery-coverage-check. A summary sample is wever_fleet-roster-sample on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict fleet_known_anecdotally, roster_gaps, roster_unverified or single_current_roster. POST /api/fleet-roster-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-handoffs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-handoffs/.
